## Mass

CAD estimate: **9.80 kg**, CG at [-0.9, -1.2, 132.1] mm (ROBOT frame, module at tilt 0). Printed parts 5.19 kg.

The v7 sim (DM-2325): 6.40 kg, CG at [14.5, 3.4, 114.7] mm.

By group: base 2.44 kg, head 0.20 kg, mast 0.61 kg, module 1.29 kg, mounts 0.50 kg, pod 4.78 kg
